tarawih.description_en: Tarawih is a special night prayer performed during Ramadan after Isha. It is a confirmed Sunnah (Sunnah Mu'akkadah). The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Whoever prays during the nights of Ramadan with faith and seeking reward, his previous sins will be forgiven.' (Sahih Al-Bukhari)
tarawih.description_id: Tarawih adalah shalat malam khusus yang dilakukan selama Ramadhan setelah Isya. Hukumnya Sunnah Mu'akkadah. Rasulullah ﷺ bersabda: 'Barangsiapa yang shalat malam di bulan Ramadhan dengan iman dan mengharap pahala, akan diampuni dosa-dosanya yang telah lalu.' (Sahih Al-Bukhari)
tarawih.timing: After Isha prayer until before Fajr
tips_en: Pray with congregation at the mosque when possible
Complete the Quran during Tarawih if possible
Make dua in witr for the Ummah
tips_id: Shalat berjamaah di masjid jika memungkinkan
Khatamkan Al-Quran selama Tarawih jika mampu
Berdoa dalam witr untuk Umat Islam

laylatul_qadr.title_en: Laylatul Qadr — The Night of Decree
laylatul_qadr.description_en: Laylatul Qadr is better than 1000 months (Quran 97:3). It falls in the last 10 nights of Ramadan, most likely on the odd nights (21st, 23rd, 25th, 27th, 29th). The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Seek Laylatul Qadr in the odd nights of the last ten nights of Ramadan.' (Sahih Al-Bukhari)
laylatul_qadr.description_id: Laylatul Qadr lebih baik dari 1000 bulan (QS 97:3). Ia jatuh pada 10 malam terakhir Ramadhan, kemungkinan besar pada malam ganjil (21, 23, 25, 27, 29). Rasulullah ﷺ bersabda: 'Carilah Laylatul Qadr pada malam-malam ganjil dari sepuluh malam terakhir Ramadhan.' (Sahih Al-Bukhari)
laylatul_qadr.dua_recommended_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
laylatul_qadr.dua_recommended_en: O Allah, You are the Most Forgiving, and You love forgiveness, so forgive me.
laylatul_qadr.dua_recommended_id: Ya Allah, Engkau Maha Pemaaf dan mencintai kemaafan, maka maafkanlah aku.
signs_en: Sunrise is weak and reddish without rays
The night is peaceful and calm
Neither too hot nor too cold
signs_id: Matahari terbit lemah kemerahan tanpa sinar

imsak.description_en: Imsak is the time to stop eating before Fajr (typically 10 minutes before). The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Take the pre-dawn meal (sahur), for indeed there is blessing in it.' (Sahih Al-Bukhari)
imsak.description_id: Imsak adalah waktu berhenti makan sebelum Subuh (biasanya 10 menit sebelumnya). Rasulullah ﷺ bersabda: 'Makan sahurlah, karena sesungguhnya dalam sahur itu ada keberkahan.' (Sahih Al-Bukhari)
imsak.dua_sahur_arabic: وَبِصَوْمِ غَدٍ نَّوَيْتُ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ
imsak.dua_sahur_transliteration: Wa bi sawmi ghadin nawaytu min shahri Ramadaan
imsak.dua_sahur_en: I intend to fast tomorrow for the month of Ramadan.
imsak.dua_sahur_id: Aku berniat puasa esok hari di bulan Ramadhan.

iftar.description_en: Break your fast at Maghrib (sunset). It is Sunnah to break with dates and water. The Prophet ﷺ said: 'The fasting person has two joys: when he breaks his fast and when he meets his Lord.' (Sahih Al-Bukhari)
iftar.description_id: Berbuka puasa saat Maghrib. Sunnah berbuka dengan kurma dan air. Rasulullah ﷺ bersabda: 'Orang yang berpuasa memiliki dua kebahagiaan: ketika berbuka dan ketika bertemu Tuhannya.' (Sahih Al-Bukhari)
iftar.dua_iftar_arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
iftar.dua_iftar_transliteration: Dhahabaz-zama'u wabtallatil 'urooqu wa thabatal ajru inshaa'Allaah
iftar.dua_iftar_en: The thirst is gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.
iftar.dua_iftar_id: Telah hilang dahaga, telah basah urat-urat, dan telah tetap pahala, insya Allah.
